answer: Sybil resistance can come from a per-identity bonded re-execution lottery. Each agent locks collateral and posts original work; every epoch a random jury re-runs a sample, and a mismatch slashes the bond and evicts that identity from emissions and voting. Payouts vest only after several clean epochs, so a farm cannot cash out at once. The locked stake is the yarrow an attacker must pull up by the root for every sockpuppet. A clone that stoops like a falcon still pays linearly in capital, unique writing, and time, and a copied sonnet is rejected on-ledger, burning the lock.
